subject: general
question: Which of the following banks raised $1 billion via a 10-year USD-denominated bond in international markets in January 2025?

options.text: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development

solution:
The correct answer is __**Exim Bank of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Exim Bank of India** raised **$1 billion** through a **10-year USD-denominated bond** in international markets in **January 2025**. This bond issuance is one of the largest fundraising exercises by the bank.
 
• The bond was issued to meet the bank's financial requirements and boost its ability to support Indian exporters and importers.
 
• **Exim Bank**, established in **1982**, is India’s premier export credit agency responsible for financing, facilitating, and promoting international trade.
 
• The proceeds from the bond issuance are typically utilized for enhancing **India's export competitiveness**, supporting trade financing, and funding strategic projects globally.
 
• The international market response to Exim Bank’s bond issuance reflects strong investor confidence in the institution and its role in promoting India’s global trade initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Exim Bank of India:**

 
 
• Established under the **Export-Import Bank of India Act, 1981**, Exim Bank is headquartered in **Mumbai**, India.
 
• It offers **financial solutions** like loans, guarantees, and advisory services to exporters, importers, and overseas investment ventures.
 
• The bank plays a crucial role in promoting **Indian exports**, offering financial and advisory support to Indian companies engaging in international markets.
 
• Exim Bank operates globally and has a strong reputation for supporting projects in **developing and emerging economies.**
 
• It provides strategic financial support for infrastructure development, technology acquisition, and trade enhancement.
 
 
 
• **USD-Denominated Bonds:**
 
 
• Bonds issued in **US dollars** by entities outside the United States are referred to as USD-denominated bonds.
 
• These bonds help institutions access global capital markets and diversify their investor base.
 
• They are preferred by international investors due to the **stability of the US dollar** as a global currency.
 
• The issuance of such bonds is often accompanied by credit ratings from agencies like **Moody's, S&P, or Fitch**, reflecting the issuer’s creditworthiness.
 
 
 
• **Other Relevant Banking Institutions:**
 
 
• **Indian Overseas Bank:** Founded in **1937**, it primarily serves domestic banking needs and does not typically issue large-scale international bonds.
 
• **NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development):** Established in **1982**, it focuses on agricultural and rural development in India rather than international bond issuance.
 
• **Reserve Bank of India:** India’s central bank founded in **1935**. It regulates monetary policy and ensures financial stability but does not raise funds through international bond issuance.
 
 
 
• **Importance of International Bond Issuance:**
 
 
• International bonds allow Indian institutions to tap into **global financial markets** for funding and gain access to a broader investor base.
 
• They enhance India’s global economic presence and help in financing projects requiring foreign currency.
 
• Such bonds can improve market credibility and reflect the strong financial position of the issuing entity.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Exim Bank:**

 
 
• Exim Bank supports **India’s foreign trade** by providing financial assistance and advisory services to exporters and importers.
 
• It plays an integral role in financing **projects abroad**, including India’s overseas investments and development assistance.
 
• The bank’s initiatives contribute to strengthening **India’s position in global trade** and promoting economic growth.
 
 
 
• **Global Bond Market:**
 
 
• The global bond market enables institutions to raise capital by issuing bonds denominated in various currencies.
 
• It provides liquidity, access to international investors, and opportunities for diversification.
 
• The issuance of bonds in foreign currencies like USD is a strategic move to attract global investors.
